question: Was the Central line between Liverpool Street and Bethnal Green ground to reduce noise, and when?
norm_question: was the central line between liverpool street and bethnal green ground to reduce noise and when

answer.text: In the Mayor's written answer to Question 2022/1791 on 28 June 2022, the Central line section from Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street is listed as having benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022.

verified_claims.text: In the spreadsheet attached to the Mayor's written answer to Question 2022/1791 on 28 June 2022, the Central line section from Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street is listed among the sections that benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022.

citations.quote:
Sections of the London Underground that have benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels (December 2021-May 2022)
Central
Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street

verified_claims.text: In the same attachment to Question 2022/1791, the provisional list of Central line sections scheduled for rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between June 2022 and November 2022 lists only Queensway to Lancaster Gate.

citations.quote:
Sections of the London Underground that will benefit from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between June 2022-
November 2022 (N.B. This list is provisional and subject to change).
Central
Queensway to Lancaster Gate

verified_claims.text: Separately from rail grinding, a 9 December 2022 letter from TfL Head of Track Duncan Weir to the Environment Committee listed eastbound Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green on the Central line among deep Tube reconditioning works planned for financial year 2023/24.

citations.quote: Deep Tube reconditioning works planned for financial year 2023/24
